design_decisions: SqlEditor checks text and text.isprintable() before cancelling the native QScintilla user list. No key allow-list, event filter, QCompleter, or custom popup was added because empty navigation-key text and non-printable acceptance/cancellation text are already excluded by that one condition.

The row offset belongs to PolarsTableModel, where vertical header labels originate. TypedSortProxyModel inherits headerData section mapping, so this keeps each absolute label associated with its record after a local sort without proxy changes.
MainWindow has one _page_row_offset helper shared by result rendering and the status range, preventing their arithmetic from drifting apart.
ResultTableView.set_frame and the existing GUI-thread test spy accept the keyword-only row_offset argument. The default remains zero for unpaged and clear-view callers.
The pre-commit hook stages formatted tracked files with git add -u. A local soft reset and temporary stash restored the required separate Task 4 and Task 5 commits without discarding work.

Offscreen tests prove list state, highlighted index, document text, and header labels, but not popup highlighting or vertical-header rendering on a real display. A user should launch ./run.sh uv run wherewolf-desktop, navigate a partial completion with Down, Up, and Tab, then page a truncated query.
Vertical-header width was measured as self-correcting and intentionally has no test. A real-display clipping issue would be a new defect.
The Spark execution tier is not exercised. Result paging is DuckDB-only and Spark paths are unchanged.
Non-DuckDB and multi-statement previews cannot page, so their row offsets remain zero by construction. This unchanged behavior was not separately verified.
